helpPage.title: Help
helpPage.introSubtitle: Manage receipt splitting and settlements easily
helpPage.introBody: PaySplit helps groups split and settle shared expenses with transparency. Check the frequently asked questions below for common issues and solutions.

items.question: How do I create a room?
items.answer: Choose create room on the home page and enter room name/password.

items.question: How do I join a room?
items.answer: Enter the room entry code, your name, and the room password.

items.question: Can I rejoin with the same name?
items.answer: Yes. Use your existing password to reconnect as the same participant.

items.question: OCR is not accurate
items.answer: Upload a clear, straight photo and review the parsed result in the editor.

items.question: Can I upload PDF files?
items.answer: Yes. PDFs go through manual editing flow instead of image OCR.

items.question: Can I edit uploaded receipts?
items.answer: Yes. You can adjust item names, prices, and quantities in receipt editor.

items.question: Which split modes are available?
items.answer: Equal split, itemized split, and manual amount input are supported.

items.question: How is settlement calculated?
items.answer: The app computes an optimized transfer plan from paid and split amounts.

items.question: Who marks settlement completed?
items.answer: Related participants can update each transfer item to completed.

supportTips: Refresh browser or clear cache and retry

sections.title: Data We Collect
items: Participant name, password, and receipt/split data
Activity logs and session data for service operation
Minimal technical data such as browser language/device

sections.title: How We Use Data
items: Provide bill splitting and settlement functionality
Authenticate room access and maintain security
Support OCR processing and quality improvements

sections.title: Retention & Deletion
items: Automatically deleted one month after settlement completion
Deletion includes files, personal data, logs, and sessions
Download archive beforehand if needed

sections.title: Sharing & Disclosure
items: We do not sell or provide personal data to third parties
Room information is shared only within the same room
Legal/security requests are handled with minimal scope

sections.title: Service Overview
items: PaySplit is a web service for group expense split/settlement
Receipt OCR and settlement calculation features are provided
Features may change according to operational policy

sections.title: Conditions of Use
items: Provide accurate data and use at your own responsibility
Comply with applicable laws and these terms
Keep passwords and access credentials secure

sections.title: Prohibited Conduct
items: Automated abuse or actions harming service stability
False input or unauthorized access attempts
Any unlawful or rights-infringing behavior

sections.title: Liability & Limitations
items: OCR accuracy may vary by input quality
Users must verify final settlement amounts
We strive for fast recovery in case of incidents
